mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% over the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month over the next 5 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS declines for 2 consecutive months over the next 60 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO increases > 1% in 1 month over the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases over the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases over the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) over two consecutive months signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases for 2 consecutive months over the next 60 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a month signals weakening supply-side fundamentals, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially in a late-cycle expansion regime.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases > 2% in 1 month over the next 60 trading days during a late-cycle expansion.
